title: The Vow of Port Alder
author: Oscar Ishikawa
blurb: Quentin Kavanagh, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
